# Tax & Compliance

This folder is derived from [billing-accounts-finance.md](../../../billing-accounts-finance.md) and represents a menu or nested submenu. Each non-README Markdown file represents one permanent table tab.

| Tab | Section slug | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [Audit Schedules](audit-schedules.md) | `audit-schedules` | Manages the end-to-end audit schedules workflow for Tax & Compliance. |

## Implementation contract

- Every listed tab is an `AppListTable` worklist or tabular report.
- Forms and workflow actions open from toolbar/row buttons in dialogs.
- Permissions, entitlement, ABAC, human-friendly IDs, export/print, audit, and targeted refresh are mandatory.
- Use the [shared finance contracts](../../_shared/README.md) for tables, dialogs, permissions, API behavior, state, and audit.
